name: Pompeiana (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pompeiana (a tree beneath three stars on yellow) within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI POMPEIANA in black arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Pompeiana, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 4 October 1986.

features.role: Pompeiana arms — tree beneath three stars on yellow, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI POMPEIANA arched above the arms
